import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

# Prepare the data for regression
X = df_merged[['iv_offshoring_1']]
y_share = df_merged['share_immi_imputed']
y_empl = df_merged['empl_immi_imputed']

# Add a constant to the predictor
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit the regression models using sklearn
model_share = LinearRegression().fit(X, y_share)
model_empl = LinearRegression().fit(X, y_empl)

# Calculate the standard error of the coefficients
n = len(y_share)
k = X.shape[1]
residuals_share = y_share - model_share.predict(X)
residuals_empl = y_empl - model_empl.predict(X)

mse_share = np.sum(residuals_share**2) / (n - k)
mse_empl = np.sum(residuals_empl**2) / (n - k)

se_share = np.sqrt(mse_share * np.diag(np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)))
se_empl = np.sqrt(mse_empl * np.diag(np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)))

# Calculate the t-statistic and p-value for the share of immigrant employment
t_stat_share = model_share.coef_[1] / se_share[1]
p_value_share = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t_stat_share), df=n - k))

# Calculate the t-statistic and p-value for the level of immigrant employment
t_stat_empl = model_empl.coef_[1] / se_empl[1]
p_value_empl = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t_stat_empl), df=n - k))

p_value_share, p_value_empl
